text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending that overnight on-street permit parking hours be extended on Sumach Street, between Eastern Avenue and Adelaide Street East, from 12:01 a.m. to 10:00 a.m., 7 days a week to the new hours of 12:01 a.m. of one day to 12:01 a.m., the following day, 7 days a week. Residents requested the extension of the overnight on-street permit parking hours on Sumach Street, to improve parking flexibility and to allow the Parking Enforcement Unit, Toronto Police Service, to effectively control long term parking by non-residents through tagging and towing operations.
The Item was withdrawn from the agenda.
